headword: {金融|きんゆう}{政策|せいさく}

definitions.explanation: Government or central bank actions to control the money supply and interest rates. In Japan, this is primarily carried out by the Bank of Japan (日本銀行). A key term in economic news.

examples.japanese: {金融|きんゆう}{政策|せいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
{日本|にほん}{銀行|ぎんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{金融|きんゆう}{政策|せいさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Bank of Japan announced a change in monetary policy.

notes:
USAGE:
A frequent term in Japanese economic news. Japan's monetary policy decisions by the Bank of Japan are closely watched both domestically and internationally.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}{緩和|かんわ}→金融緩和：24263_kinyuukanwa⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ (monetary easing policy)
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}{引|ひ}き{締|し}め→金融引き締め：26659_kinyuuhikishime⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ (monetary tightening policy)
- {金融|きんゆう}{政策|せいさく}⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦{会合|かいごう}→会合：02605_kaigou⟧ (monetary policy decision meeting)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財政|ざいせい}{政策|せいさく}→財政政策：26281_zaiseiseisaku⟧: fiscal policy — government spending and taxation decisions, as opposed to central bank monetary controls
